sources.observed: Metadata, displayed Commons preview and the entire media-viewer photograph inspected natively. Deep dark main beams, separately visible upper / lower flanges, shaped projecting rafter ends, sloping separate glass panes, short steel brackets with diagonal braces over thick red columns, recessed window frames, pale green window header panels, variegated grey-brown brick and black single-line F20 / John Goodsell fascia. Original upload URL returned 429; this pass does not claim successful original-size file inspection. No source image pixels are redistributed as game textures.

Official Street View inspected facing the courtyard. Four visible tall window rows in deep brick piers, pale header panels, projecting stepped light roof fascia, red-column glazed entrance structure, paved court, tree planter and timber benches. Historical appearance evidence; not a current access survey.

Official page confirms K-F20 John Goodsell identity and lower-ground teaching rooms. Existing university exterior-photo reference is retained; the fresh detailed visual comparison used Commons and Street View above.

preserved: Raw sixteen-vertex building outline, original 15 m / six-level OSM tags, 15 m model roof above the retained courtyard foundation, lower masonry down the unchanged public DEM slope, original building collision, existing courtyard paving and inventory tree coordinates / size bands.

reconstruction.frontFace: Raw edge 9 to 8 facing Commerce / Catherine Harris Courtyard. Four visible rows use real cut-out window apertures and 0.32 m brick reveals. Entrance glazing has a 0.18 m recess. Brick pieces and apertures partition the complete face without overlap; no opaque backing wall remains behind the glass.
reconstruction.brick: Generated stretcher-bond grey-brown / muted tan palette with subtle per-brick grain. Texture scale, mortar, exact colours and random brick pattern are estimates, not a photographed brick inventory.
reconstruction.canopy: Seven tapered I-section rafters and six separate sloping glass panes, deep front / rear main beam webs with broad flanges, short bearing brackets and diagonal braces above sixteen-sided red columns. Front beam underside 3.05 m, top 3.38 m; red column top 2.72 m; rafter maximum 3.92 m, all relative to the courtyard base. Shape / dimension estimates fitted to the photograph, not fabrication drawings.
reconstruction.rearAttachment: The canopy axis differs slightly from the exact source wall axis. The rear beam was moved outward by 0.22 m so its full flange stays in front of the brick plane at both ends, correcting an occlusion found during the native walk-through.
reconstruction.glassAndSign: Local exterior reflection probe, divided door glazing, thin pale frames, yellow safety band and single-line black entrance fascia. Pane divisions, material properties and font are reconstructed; temporary paper notices are not represented as current information.
reconstruction.collision: Conservative canopy prism bounds the full projecting steel frame from 3.05 to 3.92 m; red column colliders remain grounded to public DEM. It preserves walking clearance but does not claim an exact fabrication-level overhead collision surface. The source building remains occupied behind its doors.
reconstruction.destination: Goodsell · red columns and shaped steel canopy, F20. Arrival clears inventory trunks and mapped buildings.

validation.automated: Final full suite passed across 89 test files. Seven dedicated tests cover source / foundation preservation, wall / aperture area partition, rafter / glass shape, column bearings, terrain clearance / canopy envelope, destination / route clearance and complete rear-beam separation from the wall. Syntax, site preparation and whitespace checks passed.
validation.native: Final entrance view and underside inspected. Rear beam is continuous after correction. Walked to the door beneath the canopy and retreated, 17 m total, with displayed elevation from 52.6 m down to 52.3 m and back to 52.6 m. Browser warning / error log empty.

limitations: Component heights, rafter pitch, column / bearing dimensions, door / window schedule, exact pier depth, brick colours and current blind positions remain photo-fitted. Less-visible elevations retain simpler approximate windows. Courtyard furniture / planter layouts have not been newly surveyed or fully reconstructed in this pass. No occupied interior access is claimed.
